visualMaster.rule: Do not infer page-specific geometry, module bundling or styling from prose. Review the actual user-provided page image and complete both visual-review passes before locking.

requiredAfterVisualReview: constraintLevel and tolerance per major object
photo masks, face-safe zones and replaceability
assetDecompositionPlan only after representative ecology gate

passBChecks: which fixed badge/meta/title groups are one bundled display object
whether any photo proxy contains page decoration
reviewProcess.lockCondition: Do not set VISUAL_MASTER_LOCKED until both passes are complete and all findings plus display-module/proxy classifications are corrected in this manifest.

displayModuleClassification.rule: Classify fixed short back-cover titles, meta badges, page labels, decorative price/code-like modules and other fixed visible microcopy with their backgrounds/icons as complete generated display modules when the Visual Master treats them as one object. Visible fixed text need not remain editable. The decorative barcode module may include the bars + exact digits 2026102400000 as one asset only if the digits are QA-checked against canonical metadata. Do not bake variable/personal copy before approval.

mayBundle: fixed surrounding back-cover badge/frame when Visual Master treats it as one object
barcodeModuleRule.hardReject: Any visible barcode digits other than 2026102400000.

photoPolicy.rule: Every real-photo slot, if present after visual review, must be a separate clipped/masked replaceable image. Use only clean standalone real/representative photos with no P08 barcode, title, badge, border, label or page decoration baked into the proxy.

systemicPreproductionGates.purpleDriftRule: #7e08f9 and nearby saturated purple must not become a dominant fill/route/background color without owner approval
systemicPreproductionGates.rule: Inherited from preproduction-page-gates-manifest.json; page-specific details still require direct P08 Visual Master review before production.

hardExecutionRejects: crop from P08.png used as a photo fill
page screenshot used as photo proxy
generic editable Figma primitives replacing an authored fixed back-cover module solely for editability
watercolor/painterly/vintage escape from V30 graphic family
binary alpha accepted solely because outside transparency is real
fixed display module flattening a replaceable real photo

qa.gate0: Pending direct visual review of actual page master plus second-pass reverse omission audit.
